title: helianthemum nummularium nothosubsp. kerneri
intro: Helianthemum nummularium nothosubsp. kerneri, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species in the family Cistaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its use as a topical treatment for wounds and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. Rockrose contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
